question: Under what temporal condition of practice are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A practice is performed for the duration of one year.
That practice is described as having been practiced when completed over that time.
Upon that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The verse does not repeat which practice is meant, relying on preceding context.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
